disambiguation: Not a content generator; it only reads and displays the history of pages created by InsightMesh.
extras: The plugin is read-only by design and makes no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: A read-only Obsidian plugin that visualizes the provenance behind the wiki pages produced by InsightMesh.
problem: Users lack visibility into the conversations, checkpoints, and decisions that led to the creation of AI-generated wiki pages.

relations.evidence: You generate the provenance data by running insightmesh-core over your AI chat transcripts.

summary: A read-only plugin that visualizes the provenance, history, decisions, and changes of wiki pages generated by InsightMesh.
